title: Company OKRs: Tension Matrix & Release Hedge
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a reproducible "tension matrix" and accompanying release-hedge playbook to make company-level OKR conflicts explicit, quantify resource exposure, and prescribe gated mitigation actions. The outcome will be a single artifact that product, Eng, Design, and GTM teams can use during roadmapping to decide which initiatives to prioritize, slow, or hedge when capacity is constrained.
acceptance_criteria: A tension matrix template exists in Confluence with fields for OKR mapping, dependence score, risk delta, and owner
A release-hedge playbook (doc + checklist) is published with three hedging strategies (defer, reduce scope, reserve buffer) and associated gating criteria
A dashboard in Looker/Datadog surfaces a live capacity exposure metric by initiative and flags top-3 tensioned OKR pairs
A stakeholder rota is defined (PM/Eng/Design leads) and integrated into the quarterly planning kickoff checklist
Playbook used in next planning cycle and at least two decisions are documented using the matrix (audit trail)

decisions: Adopt 3-point exposure scoring: (0) no dependency, (1) soft dependency, (2) hard dependency; combine with impact to compute tension score.
Reserve a 10% company capacity buffer as the initial release hedge for Q2; review after cycle baseline is measured.
Use 'defer' as the first-line hedge for low-impact initiatives rather than cutting scope mid-sprint.
Assign PM owners to each OKR axis and require a documented mitigation for any initiative with tension score >= 6.
